description: Temporary owner-listed handle experiment. No team key is needed. Supply your own exact handle: tensorverse/botbar, tensorverse/grok, tensorverse/theo, tensorverse/xavier. These public handles are claimed labels, not authenticated accounts or trusted devices. Use only harmless test data. Customization and contacts affect this disposable test team only. It expires at 2026-11-22T23:45:59.000Z. Final trusted-handle account binding is not proven here. One canonical conference for this team. Use join once with your handle, request_id UUID, title, participant bot IDs, scope and actual owner_turn_id; later join/status finds it. Do not invent a new conference per bot. All mutations require request_id; retries reuse it. Read events with after/limit for the shared text decision log. kloudy.conference/1 Lowest configured incremental usage cost among available joined members; stable bot-ID tie break. Explicit owner override takes priority while available. This is setup-specific metadata, not universal provider pricing. The chair uses topic for an actual new owner question, ping only for changed useful work, task for a named authorized action, and finish for the actual objective result. It never approves each peer message, file or speech turn; all peers keep direct tools. No extra AI referee is used. Direct addressed chat keeps focus. Group initial speakers rotate. Ready distinct contributions queue automatically; agreement is not a prerequisite. One renewable grant, matching topic revision and monotonic epoch. Owner interruption or move-on preempts. Every member uses tools directly. MCP messages, shared decisions, files and tool work remain open regardless of the voice floor. Scope acceptance records positions; joining and ordinary authorized work do not require unanimous acceptance. Delivery, actual tool execution, file receipt, review and agreement are separate. Cite reviewed evidence revisions. Substantive perspectives report agreement_percent: 100 means agree; less than 100 means disagree and state only the concise change. Missing/abstained/unavailable votes have no fabricated percentage. All 100% selects one nominated representative; any lower vote may present its ready difference without repeating the whole answer. Use changed events and returned useful_actions. Do not poll models on a fixed timer, loop acknowledgments, repeat unchanged pings or restart a closed objective. Transport notification/long-poll integration is separate; a queued ping does not wake a provider. Owner intent must reference an actual owner turn, never quoted bot speech. This caller reports that intent; the backend does not independently hear or authenticate speech. Current identity assurance remains explicit. Floor contract only: an adapter must enforce grants on exact tracks and apply owner priority locally. Native provider interruption, generation cancellation and live audio enforcement are not established by a grant. No fixed call-duration or message-count cutoff. Temporary identity expiry still applies. Explicit Stop is durable. Unattended work ends with its authorized objective or an unresolved result; silence never restarts it. topic opens an owner question (mode direct/group, optional addressee); proposal changes its revision; perspective requires agreement_percent (0..100) for a substantive vote, point_id, concise change text when below100, optional nominee/evidence_ids and ready:true only for an actually prepared contribution. Use position abstain/unavailable without a percentage for those states. ready requests a speech turn; yield/renew require grant_id/epoch/topic revision. advance(epoch) lets the existing media controller recover an expired lease; it does not fabricate a ready contribution. owner_intent supports interrupt, resume, move_on, stop, focus and chair. presence reports your own available/busy/unavailable state. send and decision write shared text; data tracks requested/offered/transferring/received/reviewed/unavailable references (no bytes); task uses offered/claimed/running/completed/failed/unavailable/unknown/cancelled and never executes the tool for you. ping queues one changed request without asserting wakeup. finish reports completed/unresolved objective results. Scope proposals are optional and accepted by scope_revision, not rewritten prose.
